text_block_list.text:
The crowd erupts into cheers and
jubilation as Air
Groove takes the victory
at the autumn Tenno
Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Both Эйр Грув and Сайленс Судзука say
they'll
remember the race for the rest of
their lives, and
they promise to have an
even more exciting
match in the future.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, Эйр Грув thanks me for
always
believing in her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
